regime.label: Dealer gamma collapsing toward neutral: a long-gamma shelf at 1040-1060 sitting on a short-gamma air pocket below 1040
evidence: Net book GEX fell 81% in one session, +3,325 on 10-29 to +614 today, and near-ATM GEX (within 20 pts of spot) dropped 68% from +4,529 to +1,458.

+1,387 net GEX at the 1050 strike still holds the shelf, but per-strike GEX turns sharply negative underneath it: -1,405 at 1020 and -1,439 at 1000, so a break below 1040 puts dealers on the amplifying side.
1,717 call OI at 1050 on 475 lots traded is the live near-money wall, 2.8 pts above spot 1047.2; the 2,032-contract 960 put wall sits 8.3% below and remains structural rather than active.
11.36% ATM IV prices a 7.49-pt daily 1 sigma, yet the future fell 15 pts (2.0 sigma) while IV rose only 0.19 vol pts, so the vol market is not paying for realized range.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1047.2 on the Dec future, down 15 pts (-1.43%, a 2.0 sigma move against the 7.49-pt 1 sigma), parks spot 2.8 pts below a max pain that has not left 1050 in eight sessions. 1,717 call OI at 1050 and +1,387 net GEX there make 1040-1060 a long-gamma shelf, but GEX reads -1,405 at 1020 and -1,439 at 1000, so that shelf is the last stabiliser above an air pocket. Volume doubled to 4,128 contracts and total OI added 1,118 to 24,130: price down with OI up is positioning building, not covering. 419 puts traded at 1020 (OI +91) is today’s live protection bid, while the 1000 put wall (1,294 OI, 112 lots, OI +2 over five sessions) is not yet live.
what_changed: Net GEX collapsed 81%, from +3,325 to +614, with near-ATM GEX down 68% to +1,458; one more session of this size flips the book short-gamma.
The near-call wall dropped from 1100 to 1050 and the near-put wall slid from 1020 to 1000 as spot fell 15 pts through the 1050 strike.
Volume doubled to 2,260 calls and 1,868 puts from 1,115 and 848, with total OI up 1,118 to 24,130 on a down day.
ATM IV rose just 0.19 to 11.36% against a 2.0 sigma move, still 0.81 vol pts below the 12.17% printed on the 10-21 selloff.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: Max pain has not budged from 1050 across all eight sessions on file, so the drift story sits entirely in the walls and the gamma. Call OI grew 1,592 since 10-23 (10,896 to 12,488, +14.6%) while put OI fell 86 to 11,642, and the growth concentrated overhead at 1080 (+314), 1100 (+246), 1050 (+226), 1090 (+215) and 1070 (+204): a ceiling built while the future traded 1053-1067 that now sits above a 1047.2 spot as overhead supply. The book flipped short-gamma on 10-21 at -1,653, rebuilt to +3,876 by 10-28, and has handed back 84% of that in two sessions. IV compressed from 12.17% on 10-21 to 10.78% on 10-27 and has only recovered to 11.36% despite today’s 2 sigma drop. P/C OI fell from 1.08 on 10-23 to 0.93, so standing positioning turned call-heavy exactly as price lost the strike that OI was built around.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1040 / 1000
strategies.rationale: 1040 marks the bottom of the long-gamma shelf (+1,387 at 1050, -107 at 1040) and GEX is -1,405 at 1020 and -1,439 at 1000 beneath it, so a break there puts dealers on the sell-into-weakness side where short gamma amplifies the move, while 11.36% IV is cheap against the 2.0 sigma range the future just delivered.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit of about 10.2 pts (1040 put 16.75 mid less 1000 put 6.55 mid) on a 40-pt wing; breakeven 1029.8, max gain 29.8 pts.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1060, which restores the +997 GEX at 1060 and re-seats the long-gamma shelf.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1070 / 1090
strategies.rationale: Spot 1047.2 sits 2.8 pts below the 1050 max-pain anchor, the matrix case for a call credit spread above spot toward the pin, and 1070 is the 25-delta call band carrying the richest vol on the board at 12.83% (25-delta skew -1.14) with 1,460 and 1,838 call OI stacked at 1080 and 1100 as the ceiling above it.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-pt wing less the 4.9-pt credit = 15.1 pts; breakeven 1074.9, max gain 4.9 pts. Size small: short-vol payoff is negative-skew, small frequent gains against rare large losses.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1080, where the 1,460-contract call OI shelf begins and the 25-delta band has been reclaimed.

S50Z26.prediction: 1040 is the decision line: holding it keeps the 1040-1060 long-gamma shelf and the eight-session 1050 max-pain anchor in control, with 7.49 pts as the daily 1 sigma. Losing 1040 on expanding volume hands the tape to a short-gamma book, with the next real shelves at the 1020 protection strike (1,110 put OI, 419 lots today) and the 1000 put wall (1,294 OI). A close back above 1060 invalidates the downside bias outright.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only, not trade advice, and no position size is implied. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1050 max-pain anchor as a tendency, not a guarantee. Defined-risk is not risk-free, and the capped max loss on each structure above does occur. At 60 DTE gamma effects are diffuse, and macro or news flow can override the option structure outright.
